'''Drew Scott Hidden mains''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Drew Scott]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15323">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15323 Hidden mains], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 16 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15323/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15323/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Drew Scott]]
* '''Published:''' 16 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hidden mains''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HB Scott LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits hidden base indicator: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' basic hidden mains deck that i built. beats down opponent and wins.

== Original post ==

'''Hidden mains'''
* '''Author:''' drew "drew man1" scott
* '''Published:''' April 16, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' basic hidden mains deck that i built. beats down opponent and wins.

=== Strategy ===

mostly old school beat down with EPP and frozen assets.

first pull dagobah and the hut, with any DB, wait till your opponent deploys something then hit'em where it hurts.this deck activates alot quick and does good against most ground decks.

against space fight there weakest location with the supa falcon fully loaded with multiple destinies, then drain on the ground, and cause loss with i hope shes all right.

easy to play.
